obligations.section: 1. The wire shape is chat completions, unmodified
obligations.obligation: Unmodified chat-completions clients work with streaming and ordinary responses using only the pinned wire fields.
obligations.mutation: Require a custom header or return a dialect-specific success envelope.

obligations.section: 1. The wire shape is chat completions, unmodified
obligations.obligation: Request and response shapes contain no fields outside the kit's pinned set.
obligations.mutation: Add a session_id request parameter or usage/trace fields to responses.

obligations.obligation: Each request returns the final assistant reply for one turn, without intermediate answers or client-executed tool calls.
obligations.mutation: Return an intermediate model answer or a tool_calls response for the client to execute.

obligations.obligation: Streaming emits ordered reply deltas and closes at terminal; tool work contributes no content chunks.
obligations.mutation: Emit a tool-progress message as assistant content or terminate before the turn ends.

obligations.obligation: Carry only output_delta and terminal, and map failures to chat-completions errors retaining code and remedy.
obligations.mutation: Emit reasoning as reply text or strip the remedy from an error message.

obligations.section: 5. The model name selects a configured agent
obligations.obligation: Configured agents are built at server startup from binding options and ambient settings; requests supply no configuration.
obligations.mutation: Rebuild agent instructions from a request field or expose per-request model ceilings.

obligations.section: 5. The model name selects a configured agent
obligations.obligation: Refuse an unknown configured-agent model name by name.
obligations.mutation: Silently use the default configured agent for an unrecognized model.

obligations.obligation: Every request uses caller-held history and a fresh ephemeral turn through the public interface, with no retained conversation.
obligations.mutation: Reuse one session across requests or route history through a private engine API.

obligations.obligation: Map the entire message list into history with empty content, preserving supported roles and text-part boundaries.
obligations.mutation: Move the final user message into content or flatten a text-part array.

obligations.obligation: Reject empty messages, unsupported roles, tool/function structures, and media with invalid_input and a remedy.
obligations.mutation: Accept a tool message or stringify a function call into conversation text.

obligations.obligation: Do not invent a final message; historical system/developer content cannot replace configured agent behavior.
obligations.mutation: Append a fabricated user prompt or override the server approval policy from history.

obligations.obligation: Close a request's ephemeral session on every completion path, including pre-turn rejection.
obligations.mutation: Leak the session when history validation rejects before stream creation.

obligations.obligation: Expose no server-held conversation identity for requests to collide with.
obligations.mutation: Add a conversation/session address to the request shape.

obligations.section: 7. A failure is never a successful completion containing an apology
obligations.obligation: A failed turn produces an error rather than a successful completion containing an apology.
obligations.mutation: Return status success with an apology after provider failure or send a success stop after streamed failure.

obligations.section: 8. Bearer-token auth, loopback bind by default
obligations.obligation: Require bearer-token authentication and bind to loopback by default.
obligations.mutation: Accept a missing/wrong token or listen on all interfaces without explicit host choice.

obligations.obligation: http-face/1 has independent additive versioning with no removed, renamed, retyped, or redefaulted behavior.
obligations.mutation: Change the default stream behavior after pinning the v1 fixture set.

obligations.obligation: Project existing interface behavior without bypassing it or shrinking it to the protocol.
obligations.mutation: Add an HTTP-only agent capability or remove binding approvals to match HTTP.

obligations.obligation: Document projection losses and do not expand this face into another full binding.
obligations.mutation: Add interactive approvals to the chat-completions protocol or omit its stated losses from guides.

obligations.obligation: Do not carry reasoning, tool, approval, usage, progress, or turn-start events in this face.
obligations.mutation: Add reasoning/tool status chunks or a usage response field.

obligations.obligation: Apply server static approvals; provide no caller-process tool or approval callback channel while retaining built-in/MCP execution.
obligations.mutation: Ask the HTTP client to approve an effect or execute its own function callback.

obligations.obligation: Instructions, provider, ceiling, tools, and storage remain server-start settings.
obligations.mutation: Accept per-request instructions or tools as agent configuration.

obligations.obligation: Exclude extension fields from chat-completions request and response shapes.
obligations.mutation: Add an owned extension field to an HTTP response despite binding extension support.

obligations.obligation: Unmodified clients pass both modes; concatenated stream text equals nonstreamed content and the matching binding terminal.
obligations.mutation: Use different output assembly for streaming, ordinary HTTP, and the binding result.

obligations.obligation: History fixtures include all permitted final roles and refusals occur before provider work without replacing server settings.
obligations.mutation: Reject a final developer message or contact the provider before refusing media.

obligations.obligation: Separate requests share no conversation and clean up sessions after success, failure, and early rejection.
obligations.mutation: Retain the prior request's seed after an HTTP failure.

obligations.obligation: HTTP conformance distinguishes unknown models, errors, missing authentication, default bind, and extra response fields.
obligations.mutation: Claim HTTP conformance using only one successful nonstreamed request.
